description: Modules intentionally excluded from the Cupid source contract because the selected kernel and pinned Qualcomm trees do not contain an ABI-equivalent implementation. They must not be replaced by Xiaomi prebuilts built against a different kernel ABI.

unavailable.name: goodix_core.ko
unavailable.reason: Cupid fingerprint node uses the Xiaomi Goodix fingerprint stack; the generic touchscreen Goodix driver is not an ABI-equivalent replacement.

unavailable.name: goodix_tee.ko
unavailable.reason: TEE companion for the Xiaomi Goodix fingerprint stack is not present in the published source tree.

unavailable.name: aw862xx_haptic.ko
unavailable.reason: AW862xx Xiaomi haptic driver is not present in the published source tree.

unavailable.name: aw8697-haptic.ko
unavailable.reason: AW8697 Xiaomi haptic driver is not present in the published source tree; qcom-hv-haptics remains source-built.

unavailable.name: fpc1540.ko
unavailable.reason: FPC1540 fingerprint driver is not present in the published source tree.

unavailable.name: wl2866d.ko
unavailable.reason: WL2866D camera regulator driver is not present in the published source tree.

unavailable.name: wl2866d_ldo.ko
unavailable.reason: WL2866D LDO companion is not present in the published source tree.

unavailable.name: mi_thermal_interface.ko
unavailable.reason: Xiaomi thermal userspace bridge is not present in the published source tree; generic thermal_config is source-built.

unavailable.name: shared_rail_scmi.ko
unavailable.reason: Xiaomi shared-rail SCMI provider is not present in the published source tree; plh_scmi/gplaf_scmi are the available source providers.

unavailable.name: shared_rail_vendor.ko
unavailable.reason: Xiaomi shared-rail vendor provider is not present in the published source tree; plh_vendor/gplaf_vendor are the available source providers.

unavailable.name: stmvl53l5.ko
unavailable.reason: ST VL53L5 ToF driver is not present in the published source tree.

unavailable.name: phy-qcom-ufs-qmp-v4-anarok.ko
unavailable.reason: The Cupid source kernel produces the Waipio UFS provider; no Anarok provider is selected for this board.

unavailable.name: phy-qcom-ufs-qmp-v4-parrot.ko
unavailable.reason: The Cupid source kernel produces the Waipio UFS provider; no Parrot provider is selected for this board.
